decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (Site plan, KHAN/PLAN/01(Existing Ground Floor Plan), KHAN/PLAN/01 (Existing and Proposed Elevations), KHAN/PLAN/02 and KHAN/PLAN/03 received 23.04.12.)  and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 11.30am -11pm, Monday to Saturday and 11.30am - 11pm on Sundays and Bank Holidays.'
Condition : 4 - The access doorway to No.80 shall have a level surface or an internal ramp between the pavement and the floor and a door handle of not more than 1m above ground level.
Condition : 5 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted for A3 restaurant purposes shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.
description: Change of use of shop (A1) to restaurant (A3) to combine it with existing neigbouring restaurant.
